validation.issue.ERR_CISA_AUTHOR_MISSING: A. The SBOM author is not specified.
Add valid author information (e.g. Organization: Example Inc.) to creationInfo.creators.
validation.issue.ERR_CISA_TOOL_MISSING.m: I. The generating tool name is not specified.
validation.issue.ERR_CISA_TOOL_MISSING.f: Add the generating tool (e.g. Tool: SBOMcraft) to creationInfo.creators.
validation.issue.WRN_CISA_TOOL_VERSION_M: I. The generating tool version may not be stated.
Give the tool name an explicit version number, such as Tool: SBOMcraft-1.2.0.
validation.issue.ERR_CISA_TIMESTAMP_MISS: J. The timestamp is invalid or not specified.
Set creationInfo.created to the exact creation time (e.g. 2026-09-21T10:00:00Z).
validation.issue.WRN_CISA_CONTEXT_MISSIN: K. Stating the SBOM generation context is recommended.
State the generation phase (e.g. Generation Context: build) in creationInfo.comment or similar.
validation.issue.ERR_CISA_RELATION_EMPTY: H. The dependency graph (Relationships) has not been built properly.
Define relationships between packages (DEPENDS_ON, CONTAINS, etc.) in the relationships array.
validation.issue.ERR_NTIA_PROVIDER_MISSI: Set supplier or originator to an accurate provider string.
validation.issue.WRN_CISA_IDENTIFIER_MIS: Add a Package URL (purl) or CPE to externalRefs.
validation.issue.ERR_CISA_WEAK_HASH_ALGO: A deprecated hash algorithm is used.
Provide a hash such as SHA256 or SHA512.
